hook.situation: You find a used item online, receive a parcel-status message, and then need to turn down a friend's plan without sounding cold. Korean chat is short, but words such as 혹시, 좀, 가능할까요, and 어려울 것 같아요 tell you how careful, flexible, or final the message is.
objectives: Understand availability, condition, price, and pickup details in secondhand-market chats.
Read parcel arrival, failed-delivery, storage, and pickup messages.
Recognize soft requests and indirect refusals in friend messages.
hook.whyItMatters: Daily chat rarely uses complete textbook sentences. You need to recognize what is being asked, how certain the plan is, and whether a refusal includes an alternative. This chapter teaches those signals through messages you are likely to read in Korea.

grammarNotes.title: 아직 있나요? / 거래 가능할까요? — checking a secondhand listing
grammarNotes.func: A secondhand-market chat usually begins by checking whether the item is still available, then asks about time, place, price, or condition. 아직 있나요? is direct and neutral. N 가능할까요? asks whether an arrangement is possible and sounds more considerate than a flat 가능해요? when contacting a stranger.

formTable.when: Checking whether the item is still available
Checking whether an arrangement is possible
Asking whether price adjustment is possible

examples.en: Hello. Is this chair still available?
examples.note: A greeting plus 아직 있나요? is a safe first message to a stranger.

examples.en: Would an in-person exchange at 7 this evening be possible?
examples.note: The message proposes both time and method, so the seller can answer clearly.

examples.en: It shows signs of use, but there are no major defects.
examples.note: 사용감 means visible wear from normal use; 하자 means a defect or problem.

examples.en: Sorry, but it is currently reserved.
examples.note: 예약 중 means another buyer has arranged the transaction but it may not be completed yet.

keyPoint.label: Availability, condition, and arrangement are separate questions
keyPoint.body: 아직 있나요? checks availability. 상태는 어떤가요? checks condition. 직거래 가능할까요? checks the arrangement. Asking one clear question at a time makes a short marketplace chat easier to understand and answer.

grammarNotes.pronunciation: 있나요 is pronounced [인나요] because ㅆ before ㄴ becomes [ㄴ]. 가능할까요 has a tense ㄲ: [가능할까요].

drill.instruction: Identify what information the buyer is checking.

englishSpeakerPitfall.right: 안녕하세요. 아직 판매 중인가요? 가격은 얼마인가요?
englishSpeakerPitfall.explanation: The clipped version can sound abrupt when contacting a stranger. A short greeting and one complete availability question keep the message polite without making it formal or wordy.

grammarNotes.title: V-아/어 놓다 / V-아/어 두다 — parcel storage and pickup status
grammarNotes.func: Parcel messages often describe an action whose result remains: a package was placed in a locker, left at the door, or stored at a pickup point. V-아/어 놓다 highlights the completed result you can now see or use. V-아/어 두다 highlights leaving something prepared or stored for later. In many delivery messages they overlap, but the practical result is the same: the item is waiting at the stated location.

formTable.when: A completed placement whose result remains
formTable.ex: 찍다 → 사진을 찍어 놓다 / 넣다 → 택배함에 넣어 놓다

formTable.when: Something is stored or prepared for later

examples.en: The parcel has been placed in the unmanned parcel locker.
examples.note: 넣어 두었습니다 tells you the action is complete and the parcel remains there.

examples.en: Because you were away, it has been stored at the security office.
examples.note: 부재중 gives the reason; 경비실 gives the pickup location.

examples.romanization: suryeong ganeung siganeun ohu du sibuteo yeol sikkajiimnida.
examples.en: Pickup is available from 2 p.m. to 10 p.m.
examples.note: 수령 means receiving or picking up; 부터…까지 gives the full time window.

examples.en: Delivery could not be completed because the address was unclear.
examples.note: -지 못했습니다 reports a failed action; the noun before (으)로 gives the cause.

keyPoint.label: Find the current location before worrying about the grammar label
keyPoint.body: 넣어 두었습니다, 보관해 놓았습니다, and 보관 중입니다 all tell you that the parcel is currently waiting somewhere. The location phrase marked by 에 is the most important information: 택배함에, 경비실에, 편의점에.

grammarNotes.pronunciation: In 놓았습니다, the ㅎ is not heard before the vowel-initial ending. 넣어 is [너어], and 수령 is pronounced [수령].

drill.instruction: Read the parcel message and identify location, status, or pickup time.
drill.model: 경비실에 보관 중입니다. → Location: security office; status: stored there now.
items: 택배함에 넣어 두었습니다. → Where is it?
오후 2시부터 수령 가능합니다. → When can pickup begin?

englishSpeakerPitfall.wrong: 보관 중입니다 means someone is putting the parcel away right now.
englishSpeakerPitfall.right: 보관 중입니다 usually means the parcel is currently being kept at that location.
englishSpeakerPitfall.explanation: N 중 can describe an ongoing status, not only an action happening at this second. In a parcel notice, it usually tells you where the item remains available for pickup.

grammarNotes.title: 혹시 / 좀 / 괜찮으면 — softening a request in chat
grammarNotes.func: Korean chat often softens a request before the main grammar appears. 혹시 signals that the speaker is checking a possibility, 좀 makes the request less blunt, and 괜찮으면 means 'if it is okay with you.' These words do not change the core action, but they show that the listener has room to say no.

formTable.ex: 혹시 시간 되면 이것 좀 봐 줄래요?

examples.en: Do you happen to have time this evening?
examples.note: 혹시 prepares the listener for a request without assuming availability.

examples.ko: 시간 되면 이 메시지 좀 봐 줄래요?
examples.romanization: sigan doemyeon i mesiji jom bwa jullaeyo?
examples.en: If you have time, could you take a look at this message?
examples.note: 시간 되면 gives an exit; 좀 softens the requested action.

examples.en: If that works for you, shall we meet in front of the station?
examples.note: 괜찮으면 checks whether the proposed location suits the other person.

examples.ko: 혹시 택배 받으면 알려 줄 수 있어요?
examples.romanization: hoksi taekbae badeumyeon allyeo jul su isseoyo?
examples.en: Could you let me know if you receive the parcel?
examples.note: -아/어 줄 수 있어요? asks whether the listener can do the favor.

keyPoint.label: Soften the assumption, not the important detail
keyPoint.body: 혹시 and 괜찮으면 leave room for refusal, while 좀 softens the size or force of the request. Keep the practical detail clear: when, where, and what action. A vague request is not automatically polite.

grammarNotes.pronunciation: 괜찮으면 is pronounced [괜차느면]: ㅎ is not heard before the vowel-initial ending, and the final consonant links forward. 혹시 is [혹씨] with a tense ㅆ.

drill.instruction: Identify which word softens the possibility, the request, or the condition.
drill.model: 혹시 오늘 시간 돼요? → 혹시 softens the possibility check.
items: 이것 좀 봐 줄래요? → Which word softens the request?
괜찮으면 내일 만나요. → What condition is offered?
혹시 시간 되면 연락 주세요. → Which two softening steps appear?

englishSpeakerPitfall.wrong: 혹시 means 'by any chance,' so it must appear in every polite request.
englishSpeakerPitfall.right: Use 혹시 when you genuinely check a possibility; use 좀 or a polite ending when the possibility itself is not in question.
englishSpeakerPitfall.explanation: 혹시 is useful but not a universal politeness marker. Overusing it can make a simple message hesitant. Match the softener to what you are actually leaving open.

grammarNotes.title: V-기는 어려울 것 같아요 / V-기 힘들 것 같아요 — a soft refusal with an alternative
grammarNotes.func: Korean often turns down a plan by describing difficulty rather than saying a flat 싫어요 or 안 돼요. V-기는 어려울 것 같아요 means 'I don't think it will be easy/possible to V.' V-기 힘들 것 같아요 is slightly more conversational. A considerate refusal usually adds a short reason or a workable alternative.

formTable.ex: 만나다 → 오늘 만나기는 어려울 것 같아요
가다 → 이번 주에는 가기 힘들 것 같아요
미안하지만 오늘은 못 갈 것 같아요

examples.ko: 미안하지만 오늘 만나기는 어려울 것 같아요.
examples.romanization: mianhajiman oneul mannagineun eoryeoul geot gatayo.
examples.en: I'm sorry, but I don't think I can meet today.
examples.note: -기는 highlights the proposed action; 어려울 것 같아요 softens the refusal.

examples.ko: 이번 주는 시간이 안 될 것 같아요. 다음 주는 어때요?
examples.romanization: ibeon juneun sigani an doel geot gatayo. daeum juneun eottaeyo?
examples.en: I don't think this week will work. How about next week?
examples.note: The alternative makes the answer useful instead of merely vague.

examples.ko: 그 가격에는 판매하기 어려울 것 같아요.
examples.romanization: geu gagyeogeneun panmaehagi eoryeoul geot gatayo.
examples.en: I don't think I can sell it at that price.
examples.note: A marketplace refusal can be polite and still state the non-negotiable point clearly.

examples.en: I can't go today, but the weekend works for me.
examples.note: -지만 contrasts the unavailable time with a possible alternative.

keyPoint.label: A soft refusal still needs a clear answer
keyPoint.body: 어려울 것 같아요 lowers the force, but the listener still needs to know whether the plan is possible. Add 오늘은, 그 가격에는, or 이번 주에는 to show exactly what is difficult. If you want the relationship to continue, add a real alternative rather than an empty 다음에 봐요.

grammarNotes.pronunciation: 어려울 것 같아요 is commonly heard as [어려울 걷 까타요]. The final ㅅ of 것 becomes [ㄷ], and the following ㄱ becomes tense.

drill.instruction: Find the refusal and the alternative in each reply.
drill.model: 오늘은 어렵고 내일은 어때요? → Refusal: today; alternative: tomorrow.
items: 이번 주에는 가기 힘들 것 같아요. 다음 주는 괜찮아요. → What is the alternative?
그 가격에는 판매하기 어려워요. → What condition is refused?
오늘은 못 가지만 주말에는 갈 수 있어요. → What remains possible?

englishSpeakerPitfall.wrong: 다음에 봐요 always promises a specific future meeting.
englishSpeakerPitfall.right: 다음 주 토요일은 어때요? gives a real alternative; 다음에 봐요 may simply close the conversation politely.
englishSpeakerPitfall.explanation: A vague 다음에 can be sincere or can be a soft social closing. If you need an actual plan, look for or propose a concrete day, time, or place.

exampleSentence.en: Yes, it is still for sale.
exampleSentence.note: The opposite status may be 예약 중 or 판매 완료.

exampleSentence.en: I'd like to meet in front of the station for the exchange.
exampleSentence.note: Confirm both time and public meeting place.

exampleSentence.en: It is currently reserved by another person.
exampleSentence.note: The sale may not yet be complete.

exampleSentence.en: It shows a little wear, but it is clean.
exampleSentence.note: A common condition word in used-item listings.

exampleSentence.en: There is no defect in how it works.
exampleSentence.note: Ask whether the defect affects appearance or function.

exampleSentence.en: It is a little difficult to adjust the price.
exampleSentence.note: A polite way to refuse bargaining.

exampleSentence.en: The parcel is in the unmanned parcel locker.
Please pick it up by the end of today.
exampleSentence.note: Common in parcel and store-pickup messages.

exampleSentence.en: Delivery could not be completed because no one was present.
exampleSentence.note: Often followed by a redelivery or pickup instruction.

exampleSentence.ko: 어려울 것 같아요는 완곡한 거절에 자주 쓰여요.
exampleSentence.en: 어려울 것 같아요 is often used for a softened refusal.
exampleSentence.note: The refusal becomes clearer when paired with a specific condition.

extendedDialogue.setting: Alex buys a used lamp, checks the parcel message, and then answers a friend's invitation.

lines.speaker: 알렉스
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 이 조명 아직 판매 중인가요?
lines.romanization: annyeonghaseyo. i jomyeong ajik panmae jungingayo?
lines.en: Hello. Is this lamp still for sale?
lines.grammarNote: A polite availability check opens the transaction.

lines.speaker: 판매자
lines.ko: 네, 아직 있어요. 사용감은 조금 있지만 하자는 없어요.
lines.romanization: ne, ajik isseoyo. sayonggameun jogeum itjiman hajaneun eopseoyo.
lines.en: Yes, it is. It shows a little wear, but it has no defects.
lines.grammarNote: -지만 contrasts wear with the lack of defects.

lines.speaker: 알렉스
lines.ko: 오늘 저녁에 역 앞에서 직거래 가능할까요?
lines.romanization: oneul jeonyeoge yeok apeseo jikgeorae ganeunghalkkayo?
lines.en: Would an in-person exchange in front of the station this evening be possible?
lines.grammarNote: The buyer proposes time, place, and method together.

lines.speaker: 판매자
lines.en: Today is difficult, but tomorrow at 7 works.
lines.grammarNote: The refusal includes a concrete alternative.

lines.speaker: 택배 알림
lines.ko: 주문하신 상품을 무인 택배함에 넣어 두었습니다.
lines.romanization: jumunhasin sangpumeul muin taekbaehame neoeo dueotseumnida.
lines.en: Your ordered item has been placed in the unmanned parcel locker.
lines.grammarNote: -아/어 두다 reports a completed action with a result that remains.

lines.speaker: 친구
lines.ko: 혹시 오늘 저녁에 같이 영화 볼래요?
lines.romanization: hoksi oneul jeonyeoge gachi yeonghwa bollaeyo?
lines.en: Would you happen to want to watch a movie together tonight?
lines.grammarNote: 혹시 softens the invitation by checking availability.

lines.speaker: 알렉스
lines.ko: 미안하지만 오늘은 가기 힘들 것 같아요. 토요일은 어때요?
lines.romanization: mianhajiman oneureun gagi himdeul geot gatayo. toyoireun eottaeyo?
lines.en: I'm sorry, but I don't think I can go today. How about Saturday?
lines.grammarNote: A soft refusal plus a real alternative keeps the plan alive.

readingText.title: 세 가지 메시지에서 필요한 정보 찾기
readingText.body:
[중고 거래] 안녕하세요. 자전거 아직 판매 중인가요? 상태가 괜찮으면 이번 주 토요일에 직거래하고 싶어요. 가격 조정도 조금 가능할까요?
[택배] 고객님이 부재중이어서 상품을 경비실에 보관해 놓았습니다. 오늘 오후 10시 전까지 수령해 주세요.
[친구 카톡] 오늘 만나기는 조금 어려울 것 같아요. 미안해요. 대신 토요일 오후에는 시간이 되는데 그때는 어때요?
readingText.bodyTranslation: [Secondhand transaction] Hello. Is the bicycle still for sale? If its condition is good, I'd like to meet for an in-person exchange this Saturday. Would a small price adjustment also be possible? [Parcel] Because you were away, your item has been stored at the security office. Please pick it up before 10 p.m. today. [Friend chat] I don't think I can meet today. Sorry. I am free Saturday afternoon instead; would that work?

comprehensionQuestions.question: 구매자는 물건에 대해 어떤 세 가지를 확인하나요?
comprehensionQuestions.answer: 판매 여부, 상태, 가격 조정 가능 여부를 확인합니다.

comprehensionQuestions.question: 택배는 어디에 있고 언제까지 찾아야 하나요?
comprehensionQuestions.answer: 경비실에 있고 오늘 오후 10시 전까지 찾아야 합니다.

comprehensionQuestions.question: 친구 메시지는 완전한 거절인가요, 다른 제안이 있나요?
comprehensionQuestions.answer: 오늘 만나는 것은 거절하지만 토요일 오후라는 다른 제안을 합니다.

culturalNote.title: Short Korean chat still carries relationship signals
culturalNote.body: A short message can be polite without being formal. 안녕하세요, 혹시, 좀, 가능할까요, and 미안하지만 show care toward a stranger or friend. On the other hand, a long explanation does not automatically make a refusal kinder. A clear condition and a realistic alternative are often more helpful.
culturalNote.tip: When reading a chat, separate the factual answer from the social cushioning. 아직 있어요 is the answer; 안녕하세요 and 가능할까요 manage the relationship. 어려울 것 같아요 is the refusal; 토요일은 어때요? is the alternative.

inlineExercises.prompt: Which opening is best for checking a stranger's listing?
inlineExercises.explanation: It is brief, complete, and appropriately polite.

inlineExercises.prompt: 사용감은 있지만 하자는 없어요. What does this mean?
options: It shows wear but has no defects
It is brand new and sealed
inlineExercises.correct: It shows wear but has no defects
inlineExercises.explanation: 사용감 is wear; 하자 is a defect.

inlineExercises.prompt: 예약 중이에요. What is the likely status?
inlineExercises.explanation: 예약 중 means a transaction has been arranged but may not be complete.

inlineExercises.prompt: 택배함에 넣어 두었습니다. Where is the parcel now?
inlineExercises.explanation: -아/어 두었습니다 tells you the completed result remains.

options: The message does not concern delivery
inlineExercises.explanation: -지 못했습니다 means the action could not be completed.

inlineExercises.prompt: 혹시 오늘 시간 돼요? What does 혹시 do?
inlineExercises.explanation: 혹시 leaves room for the listener not to be available.

inlineExercises.prompt: 이것 좀 봐 줄래요? What does 좀 do here?
inlineExercises.explanation: 좀 often lowers the force of an everyday request.

inlineExercises.prompt: 오늘은 어렵고 내일은 어때요? What is the alternative?
inlineExercises.explanation: The message refuses today and proposes tomorrow.

inlineExercises.prompt: 그 가격에는 판매하기 어려울 것 같아요. What is being refused?
inlineExercises.explanation: 그 가격에는 limits the refusal to the proposed price.

inlineExercises.prompt: Which reply gives a real alternative?
options: 오늘은 못 가요. 토요일 오후는 어때요?
inlineExercises.correct: 오늘은 못 가요. 토요일 오후는 어때요?
inlineExercises.explanation: It clearly refuses today and proposes a concrete new time.

bullets: Secondhand chat: check availability, condition, arrangement, and price separately.
Parcel messages: find the current location, completion status, and pickup deadline.
혹시 checks a possibility, 좀 softens a request, and 괜찮으면 leaves the choice open.
-기는 어려울 것 같아요 gives a soft refusal; a concrete alternative makes the answer useful.
In short chat, separate the factual answer from the words that manage the relationship.

writingTask.prompt: Read the marketplace, parcel, and friend messages. For each one, write a one-line English summary containing only the decision or required action.
writingTask.hint: Marketplace: status and arrangement. Parcel: location and deadline. Friend chat: refused time and alternative.
writingTask.model: 예약 중이에요. → The item is currently reserved. / 토요일은 어때요? → Today is not possible; Saturday is the alternative.
writingTask.modelEn: This task checks message comprehension, not Korean composition.

canDo: Understand whether a secondhand item is available, reserved, defective, or negotiable
Locate a parcel and identify a failed delivery or pickup deadline
Recognize how 혹시, 좀, and 괜찮으면 soften a chat request
Distinguish a vague social closing from a refusal that offers a concrete alternative
